brief: 提取树干呼吸速率数据，必须报告物种，并关注研究站点。

blocks.text: The experiment was conducted at the Alpine Forest Research Site.
The measured species was Pinus sylvestris, with five mature trees sampled.
Mean stem respiration was 1.8 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 at 20 °C.
Soil water content varied during the observation season.
